sanjay: Quick RFC follow-up — proposing a lightweight 'AttentionShim' interface to unify fused-QKV, fused-bias/rope, and dropout-free paths so runtime can pick kernels without model code changes.
elaine: +1. Can you sketch the contract? shapes/batch dim assumptions are the trick.
sanjay: Sketch:
```
class AttentionShim:
  def prepare(input: Tensor): (qkv_buffer, seq_len, batch)
  def run(qkv_buffer): Tensor
  # optional hooks: prefetch_kv(), apply_rope()
```
Must support both packed (QKV fused) and separate Q/K/V layouts. No runtime memory copies for 2D+batch-as-first dims.
frank: Important: need explicit stride/align invariants. For example 16B alignment for A100_amx kernels. Also we must expose `supports_dropoutless: bool` so caller can avoid dropout ops in inference.
tomas: How are we handling legacy models with custom op graphs? We should offer an opt-in shim layer at model load time and a deprecation path for old kernels.
sanjay: Plan:
- shim interface v1 (backwards compatible) -> land in runtime
- provide per-model annotation to opt-in (model_metadata.attention_shim = "auto"|"none"|"strict")
- telemetry to detect fallback to generic kernels
- deprecate old fused ops after 3 months of telemetry showing <1% fallbacks
elaine: Tests: add microbench suite under eng-runtime/tests/attention_shim to validate perf parity and fallback costs. Add a synthetic driver that toggles batch/seq pairs.
infra-bot: canary deploy started: runtime-attention-shim-v1 -> cluster/canary-4
frank: One more: specify ABI for KV cache layout used by shim so downstream long-sequence cache reuse is zero-copy.
sanjay: Agreed. I'll author a short RFC appendix with exact byte layout, stride examples, and a small C header. Will ping reviewers @elaine @frank for review.
qa-bot: reminder: please add a release note and a changelog entry for the API opt-in flag.
elaine: SGTM. Also include migration notes for Dedicated customers — add config toggle in console UI.
frank: can we add a debug env var: RUNTIME_ATTENTION_SHIM=trace to log selected kernel decisions? helps investigations.
sanjay: done. I'll push a PR with shim skeleton + tests by EOD. Thanks all :rocket:
